items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Now this fellow's name is Parnaret. That's a clarinet player.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's a trombone, but I think he gave it up. And that's me. And this is Albert Warner. Now this fellow's name is Parnaret. That's a clarinet player. Now this is Albert Francis, the one I told you about.
